name: slack-agora
description: Agora: a Slack bot for a team to receive messages, including anonymous ones, answer them together from a private channel, and post as the bot

scripts.version: grep -q "^## \[$npm_package_version\]" CHANGELOG.md || { echo "CHANGELOG.md has no section for $npm_package_version: add it and commit it, undo the version change with git checkout package.json, and try again" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.postversion: echo "Tagged v$npm_package_version. Release it with: git push --follow-tags"
